title: planned_down
description: Phone → watch. The phone's planned sessions: only the not-started plans inside the phone's sync window travel, and the wrist keeps only the rows whose scheduled day equals its own local today. One frame, never batched; sent from the same bundle that answers a routine request, so it travels with every `routines_down`.

payload.description: Only the not-started plans for the phone's local today give or take the sync window travel; the wrist filters to its own today, so a plan scheduled for the phone alone may never start here.

plan.description: One planned session row as the phone stores it: what to call it, when it is scheduled, and where it came from.

name.description: The phone's name cascade: the plan's own title, else its routine template's name, else the phone's modality label, else "Free Training".

scheduledDateMs.description: The phone's local start of day for the scheduled date, in epoch milliseconds as stored.

routineTemplateId.description: The routine the plan was created from, on a routine plan. Omitted (never null) when the plan is a free workout.

modality.description: The phone's modality label, on a free plan with one. Omitted (never null) when the plan has none.
